scientific_integrity: Every claimed count follows from the finite feedback permutation parametrization and is independently checked by Euler tours and two palindromic-subsequence dynamic programs. The complete standalone checker and machine-readable counts are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Complete, exhaustive finite classification for binary de Bruijn order 5 only; no higher-order theorem, historical-priority guarantee, or externally independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact circular palindromic-subsequence spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
